name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-christmas-julfest-bingo
title: Christmas & JulFest Bingo
shortDescription: Creates or repairs English Christmas Bingo and Swedish JulFest Bingo SharePoint lists and interactive game views from a bundled canonical template.
longDescription: Sets up a festive bingo game inside SharePoint lists. The skill creates or reuses an English Christmas Bingo Cards list and a Swedish JulFest Bingo list, seeds each with a 36-word themed word bank, and adds a non-default HTML game view built from a bundled view-formatting template.

Players get a shuffled 5x5 card with a free centre, a Caller/Player role switch, called-word history, undo, win patterns for lines, four corners, or full house, verified claims with a success banner and confetti, SharePoint theme-aware colors, a How to play drawer, and print support.
The game state is local to each browser. SharePoint does not sync it between devices: the Caller announces words and each Player logs them on their own device.
